name: Meeting
agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING
OF THE
CITY COUNCIL AND
REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
THURSDAY - JUNE 23, 2011 - CITY HALL -
07:00 P.M.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, BLOOMFIELD AVENUE AT 183RD STREET
A G E N D A
Public input will be allowed on all Agenda items at the time each matter comes up for discussion. Please complete and submit a blue Speaker's Card to ensure that you are recognized when the Agenda item is considered.
1.
Call to Order
2.
Invocation
3.
Pledge of Allegiance
4.
Roll Call
5.
Presentations
6.
Public Comments
7.
Consent Calendar
8.
Approval of Registers & Minutes
9.
Ordinance No. 961 adopting by reference the Los Angeles County Residential Code and amending Title 15 of the Cerritos Municipal Code.
10.
PUBLIC HEARINGS
10A.
Public hearing to receive comments on, waive reading of, and adopt the Resolution of the City Council of the City of Cerritos adopting the 2010 Urban Water Management Plan pursuant to California Water Code 10610 to 10657.
10B.
Combined Financial Program for the City of Cerritos and Cerritos Redevelopment Agency for Fiscal Year 2011-2012. Consideration to waive reading and adopt a Joint Resolution of the Cerritos City Council and Cerritos Redevelopment Agency approving and adopting the annual budget for the Fiscal Year 2011-2012, appropriating the funds necessary to meet the expenditures set forth therein, and approving the City of Cerritos’/Cerritos Redevelopment Agency’s Investment Policy for the Fiscal Year 2011-2012.
10C.
Consideration to waive reading of and adopt a Joint Resolution of the Cerritos City Council and Cerritos Redevelopment Agency approving a report pursuant to California Health and Safety Code Sections 33445 and 33679 and authorizing the Cerritos Redevelopment Agency to fund portions of the City of Cerritos/Cerritos Redevelopment Agency Capital Improvement Program for Fiscal Year 2011-2012.
10D.
Consideration to waive reading of and adopt a Resolution of the Cerritos City Council approving the agreement between the City of Cerritos and the City of La Mirada, California, regarding the exchange of Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) funds for General Funds for the Fiscal Year 2011-2012.
Recess
Reconvene
11A.
Adopt a Resolution in support of an action taken by the League of California Cities, Los Angeles Division, supporting reasonable, practicable and economically achievable storm water National Pollutant Discharge Elimination System permit requirements and total maximum daily load requirements through the use of progressive and adaptive best management practices.
11B.
Consideration and award of contract for traffic signal and street lighting maintenance services for the City of Cerritos.
11C.
Consideration of a traffic control signal agreement between the cities of Bellflower, Cerritos, Lakewood for traffic signal operation, maintenance and repair at the intersection of Palo Verde Avenue and Allington/183rd Street.
11D.
Consideration to waive reading of and adopt a Resolution of the City Council of the City of Cerritos approving an application for Los Angeles County Regional Park and Open Space District for Fourth Supervisorial District funding for Capital Improvements at Cerritos Park East.
12A.
Consideration and review of an amendment to the existing Granicus agreement for additional functionality and customer service related to agenda and records management.
12B.
Consideration and review of the First Draft Assembly, Senate, State Board of Equalization and Congressional District Maps proposed by the Citizens Redistricting Commission in Accordance with Proposition 11 (2008) and Proposition 20 (2010) as it relates to the City of Cerritos.
12C.
Consideration to waive reading of and adopt a Resolution of the Cerritos City Council in opposition to SB 931 (Vargas) as it relates to the public employee organizations and proposes to prohibit public agencies from using public funds to pay for external consultants or legal advisers to counsel employer.
13.
REPORT ON PENDING LEGISLATION
14.
CITY COUNCIL COMMUNICATIONS/COMMITTEE REPORTS/REPORT ON MEETINGS
15.
ADJOURNMENT
